requirements.title: Event ingestion endpoint
requirements.description: POST /api/v1/events accepts proto-JSON EventEnvelope, validates required fields, returns 202 Accepted.

requirements.title: Envelope field validation
requirements.description: Validates required fields (eventId, sourceScenario, eventType) and rejects malformed bodies

requirements.title: Structured error codes for validation failures
requirements.description: Returns machine-readable error codes (missing_field, invalid_body) for client-side error handling

requirements.title: Dry-run support
requirements.description: X-Dry-Run header skips persistence and broadcast while running full validation

requirements.title: Event query endpoint
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/events with query params: type (glob), source, correlation_id, since, limit

requirements.title: Health endpoint
requirements.description: GET /health returns store stats, subscriber count, status

requirements.title: Error code to HTTP status mapping
requirements.description: Maps validation error codes to appropriate HTTP status codes (400, 409)

requirements.title: Dry-run validation response
requirements.description: Returns validation result with would-be event ID without persisting

requirements.title: Query parameter parsing and validation
requirements.description: Parses type, source, correlation_id, since, limit with type coercion and bounds

requirements.title: Glob pattern filter for type parameter
requirements.description: Type parameter supports glob matching against event_type field

requirements.title: Response format and pagination
requirements.description: Returns JSON array with total count header for client-side pagination

requirements.title: Store statistics collection
requirements.description: Collects event count, database size, and oldest event timestamp from store

requirements.title: Size reporting in human-readable format
requirements.description: Database size returned in bytes with human-readable formatted string

requirements.title: Active subscriber count
requirements.description: Reports current SSE subscriber count from broker state
